ranking_transform: absolute value of the DIFF_LOG2_SUM score, sorted descending; no quantile calibration ('raw' means uncalibrated, not untransformed)
tie_handling: pandas sort_values default (quicksort), ties arbitrary; VERIFIED: no tie spans a reported cutoff at depth 25, 50, 100 or 200 for any of the seven rankings, so tie order changes no reported result
note: the seven ranked outputs are not the six tissues defining the shared-peak panel; they are separate lists
partition_rule: a merged kidney peak is SHARED if a comparison peak covers its midpoint, otherwise KIDNEY-RESTRICTED
coordinate_convention: GRCh38, BED half-open [start, end), 0-based; intervals unclipped at locus bounds
resampling_fixed_set: all variants not inside a kidney-restricted peak, which includes variants in shared kidney peaks
multi_allelic_handling: alternate alleles at one position share a position and therefore always travel together within one resampling unit
top_set_membership: recomputed within each resample, not held fixed
repeated_peaks: a peak drawn k times contributes its variants k times to both the top set and the denominator
zero_cells: Haldane 0.5 correction on the bootstrap log odds ratios, so no replicate is infinite; the reported point estimates and exact intervals are uncorrected conditional maximum likelihood
scorer_aggregation: DIFF_LOG2_SUM: difference of log2 summed signal between ALT and REF over the centred mask
position_base: gnomAD pos is 1-based; context start = max(0, pos - 524288)
coverage_convention: peaks CLASSIFIED unclipped; coverage percentages computed from the intersection with the evaluated interval. One merged peak at APOL1-MYH9 overhangs by 447 bp; none overhangs at the comparison locus
resampling_units: 27 kidney-restricted peaks containing at least one eligible allele, of 39 such peaks
bootstrap_estimator: Haldane-corrected log cross-product ratio, used for BOTH the observed point and every replicate; NOT the conditional maximum-likelihood OR of Table 1
stability_design: 9 configurations (3 replicate counts x 3 seeds) yielding 54 comparator-specific intervals
